title: Which Studio Ghibli character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Studio Ghibli quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Chihiro, Kiki, Sophie, Howl, San, Nausicaä, Haku or Totoro. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
h1: Which Studio Ghibli character are you?
lede: Brave like Chihiro, independent like Kiki or calm like Totoro? Answer 12 questions about your habits, fears and favorite places to find your Ghibli match.
about: Studio Ghibli's films are full of characters who grow quietly: a scared girl who saves her parents, a young witch who loses her magic and finds it again, a woman cursed with old age who finds her confidence. This quiz matches you with eight of them, from Spirited Away, Kiki's Delivery Service, Howl's Moving Castle, Princess Mononoke, Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind and My Neighbor Totoro.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Studio Ghibli or Hayao Miyazaki; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Chihiro (Spirited Away), Kiki (Kiki's Delivery Service), Sophie and Howl (Howl's Moving Castle), San (Princess Mononoke), Nausicaä (Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind), Haku (Spirited Away) and Totoro (My Neighbor Totoro).

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Why isn't my favorite character here?
faq.a: Eight results keep the quiz short and fair. Ponyo, Kaonashi and others may join in a later update.
No. It is a free fan quiz, and your answers stay in your browser.

chihiro.name: Chihiro
chihiro.body: You may start out scared, but when it counts you work hard, keep your promises and don't give up on the people you love. Like Chihiro in Spirited Away, you grow braver with every step into the unknown.

kiki.name: Kiki
kiki.body: You want to make it on your own and find what you're good at. Some days the magic fades, and that's okay: like Kiki, you find it again by resting, making friends and remembering why you started.

sophie.name: Sophie
sophie.body: You are practical, kind and much stronger than you think. You quietly keep everyone going. Like Sophie in Howl's Moving Castle, you shine when you stop believing you're plain.

howl.name: Howl
howl.body: You are charming, creative and a little dramatic, with a big heart you don't always show. Like Howl, you'd rather avoid hard things, but you're brave when it matters to the people you love.

san.name: San
san.body: You are fierce, independent and loyal to what you believe in. You don't trust easily, but once you do, it's for life. Like San in Princess Mononoke, you stand up for those who can't defend themselves.

nausicaa.name: Nausicaä
nausicaa.body: You are curious, compassionate and brave, and you look for understanding where others see enemies. Like Nausicaä, you bring people, and creatures, together.

haku.name: Haku
haku.body: You are calm, a little mysterious and fiercely protective of your friends. You don't say much, but you're always there when needed. Like Haku, you're still discovering who you really are.

totoro.name: Totoro
totoro.body: You are gentle, playful and calming to be around. You don't worry much, and you show up when someone needs a friend. Like Totoro, you make the world feel a little more magical.
